summary: Cashier with roughly a decade of retail and front-end experience across apparel, grocery, and front-desk settings, spanning cash handling, point-of-sale operations, and customer service. Skilled in processing cash and card transactions, issuing refunds and exchanges, opening and closing registers, and reconciling drawers. Also brings merchandising, stock rotation, and inventory control experience, including displays, signage, and receiving shipments, plus conflict resolution and personalized product recommendations. Associate of Arts holder with a focus on guidance, seeking roles of increased responsibility where sales and service skills add value.
